metadata.title: Office Layout - Intermediate 1
metadata.author: Dr. SAID MAARAK
metadata.chapter: The Pitfalls of the Commercial Lease

questions.question: Dr Ramdan discovers that his lease does not specify who should pay the condominium charges. According to Article 5 of Law 49-16, what should he do?
options: Pay the charges because he is the tenant
Contest because unspecified charges are included in the rent
Share the charges 50/50 with the landlord
Request an immediate court-appointed expert appraisal
questions.explanation: Art. 5, para. 2: in the absence of a stipulation as to which party bears the charges, they are considered to be included in the rent.

questions.question: Dr Kamali receives a rent revision proposal of 50% without valid justification. According to Article 5, which law governs this revision?
options: Law No. 49-16 only
Law No. 07-03 relating to rent revision
Law No. 65-00 on health insurance
Law No. 15-95 of the commercial code
questions.explanation: Art. 5, para. 3: the revision of the rent is subject to the provisions of Law No. 07-03.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord includes a clause stating: 'The tenant expressly waives the renewal of the lease'. According to Article 6, is this clause valid?
options: Yes, if signed before a notary
No, because it is contrary to public policy
Yes, because the tenant is free to waive
No, but only during the first 3 years
questions.explanation: Art. 6: leases governed by the law only terminate by application of Article 26. Any contrary stipulation is null.

questions.question: Dr Kamali has installed expensive dental equipment in his practice. According to Article 7, how will this installation be valued in the event of eviction?
options: It is not taken into account
It is included in the value of the business
It is compensated separately at the purchase price
It is only tax deductible
questions.explanation: Art. 7, para. 3: the compensation includes the value of the business, estimated on the basis of the tax declarations of the last four financial years.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan carried out compliance works without the landlord's authorization. According to Article 8, what risk does he face?
options: No risk if the works are useful
Loss of his right to eviction compensation, unless regularized within 3 months
A simple reminder letter
A 20% rent increase
questions.explanation: Art. 8, 2°: the landlord is exempt from compensation if the tenant transforms the premises, unless he restores the premises within a period not exceeding 3 months.

questions.question: Dr Kamali's landlord wishes to demolish and rebuild the building. According to Article 9, what prerequisite condition must he respect?
options: Obtain the tenant's written consent
Prove ownership for 1 year from the date of the notice
Pay a deposit of 200,000 DH
Obtain a certificate of conformity
questions.explanation: Art. 9, para. 1: the landlord must prove ownership for a period of at least one year from the date of the notice.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan estimates his eviction loss at 800,000 DH. According to Article 7, on what document does he base his justification?
options: On equipment purchase invoices
On the tax declarations of the last four financial years
On a real estate agent's valuation
On the amount of rent paid
questions.explanation: Art. 7, para. 3: the compensation is calculated on the basis of the tax declarations for the last four financial years.

questions.question: Dr Kamali has sublet part of his practice to a colleague. According to Article 24, if the sublease rent is higher than the main rent, what can the landlord do?
options: Nothing, he has no rights
Request a revision of the main rent
Immediately terminate the lease
Evict the subtenant
questions.explanation: Art. 24, last para.: when the value of the sublease exceeds that of the main lease, the lessor is entitled to a revision of the rent amicably or by judicial means.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan wishes to assign his lease to a young dentist. According to Article 25, what obligation must he respect?
options: Obtain the landlord's consent before the assignment
Notify the assignment to the landlord for it to be enforceable
Pay an assignment fee of 10% of the rent
Wait for the end of the lease to assign
questions.explanation: Art. 25, para. 3: the assignment is only enforceable against the lessor from the date of notification.

questions.question: Dr Kamali's landlord evicts him for non-payment of rent. According to Article 26, what is the applicable eviction period?
options: 3 days
15 days
1 month
3 months
questions.explanation: Art. 26, para. 2: the period is set at 15 days when the request is based on non-payment of rent.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan is being sued for non-compliance with the clauses of his lease. According to Article 26, what deadline can the tenant benefit from?
options: 15 days
1 month
3 months
6 months
questions.explanation: Art. 26, para. 2: the period is set at 3 months when the request is based on a serious reason relating to the tenant's non-compliance with the lease clauses.

questions.question: According to Article 26, does Dr Kamali's landlord have a deadline to request validation of the notice?
options: Yes, he has 3 months
Yes, he has 6 months
Yes, he has 1 year
No, validation can be requested at any time
questions.explanation: Art. 26, para. 6: the lessor is forfeited from the right to request validation of the notice after six months from the expiry of the period granted to the tenant.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan discovers that the landlord sold the building without notifying him. According to Article 26 bis, what right must the new owner respect?
options: He may terminate the lease without notice
He must respect the existing lease
He may increase the rent by 30%
He may require a new security deposit
questions.explanation: Art. 26 bis: the new owner is required to respect existing leases regularly concluded.

questions.question: Dr Kamali has requested eviction compensation. According to Article 27, when can he request it?
options: Only after effective eviction
During the action for validation of the notice
After the construction of the new building
Only on appeal
questions.explanation: Art. 27, para. 2: the tenant may file a request for compensation during the action for validation of the notice.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord obtains an eviction judgment. According to Article 28, within what time limit must he deposit the compensation?
options: 1 month
2 months
3 months
6 months
questions.explanation: Art. 28: the lessor is required to deposit the amount of compensation within a period of three months from the date on which the judgment becomes enforceable.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to know which premises are excluded from the benefit of Law 49-16. According to Article 1, which types of premises are not covered?
options: Office premises
Premises of liberal professionals
Tourism premises
Premises of training establishments
questions.explanation: Art. 1, II-6: tourism premises benefit from an express exclusion from the scope of the law.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan notices that his lease mentions a duration of 9 years. According to Law 49-16, is this duration compliant?
options: Yes, the minimum duration is 9 years
No, the maximum duration is 9 years, not minimum
Yes, it is the recommended standard duration
No, the duration must be 3 years renewable
questions.explanation: Law 49-16 sets a maximum duration of 9 years, not a minimum. The parties are free to agree on a shorter duration.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wishes to renew his lease after 9 years. According to Article 4, what are his chances of renewal?
options: None, the lease ends after 9 years
He benefits from the right to renewal
He must negotiate a new lease at the same value
He is only entitled to a 3-year extension
questions.explanation: Art. 4: the tenant benefits from the renewal of the lease when he proves continuous enjoyment of the premises for at least two years.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan's landlord imposes a mandatory arbitration clause. According to the general provisions of Law 49-16, is this clause valid?
options: Yes, arbitration is recommended
No, because it is contrary to the right of access to justice
Yes, if accepted with full knowledge
No, unless both parties are merchants
questions.explanation: Law 49-16 protects the rights of the parties. A mandatory arbitration clause would be contrary to the right of access to justice.

questions.question: Dr Kamali receives a court summons. According to Article 28, what must the landlord do after the judgment for the eviction to be effective?
options: Deposit the amount of compensation within 3 months
Wait for the tenant's appeal
Proceed with immediate eviction
Wait for the tenant to find other premises
questions.explanation: Art. 28: the lessor is required to deposit the amount of compensation within a period of three months from the date on which the judgment becomes enforceable.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan signed a lease without an initial inventory. According to Article 3, how will he prove the initial condition of the premises?
options: He cannot prove it, which is to his disadvantage
He can use photos and testimonies
He can request a judicial inventory
All of these solutions are possible
questions.explanation: Art. 3: the inventory is mandatory. In its absence, the tenant may use other means of proof.

questions.question: Dr Kamali received a notice of eviction for demolition. According to Article 18, what document must the landlord produce?
options: A building permit and an approved plan
A simple project declaration
An agreement from the co-owners
A certificate from the town hall
questions.explanation: Art. 18: the landlord must produce a valid building permit and a plan approved by the competent authority.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan has doubts about the legality of his lease. According to Article 3, what is the mandatory form requirement for a commercial lease?
options: An oral contract is sufficient between professionals
A written deed with a fixed date is mandatory
A declaration to the town hall replaces the contract
A simple agreement in principle is sufficient
questions.explanation: Art. 3: commercial leases must be concluded by written deed with a fixed date.

questions.question: Dr Kamali wonders about the eviction compensation. According to Article 7, what is the nature of this compensation?
options: A flat-rate compensation
A compensation for the loss suffered
A punitive compensation
A voluntary departure allowance
questions.explanation: Art. 7: the compensation corresponds to the loss suffered by the tenant as a result of the eviction.

questions.question: Dr Ramdan obtained a favorable judgment. According to Article 28, what is the deadline for the landlord to execute the judgment?
options: 1 month
2 months
3 months
6 months
questions.explanation: Art. 28: the lessor is required to execute the judgment within a period of three months from the date on which the judgment becomes enforceable.
